title: Clean Active Window Mark
description: Active window mark should be the same fine line as inactive chrome (1px border-element weight) but with primary (active-base) color instead of a thick ring-2 inset.
summary: Active window mark no longer adds an inner border on Window. When a stack owns the globally active window, the existing U-shaped chrome (tab cap, controls cap, stack body) swaps border-element for border-active-base on the same 1px strokes.
